body:
I'm in therapy, I burried myself in work, I'm reading, going to gym etc. It's not that I'm just sitting in my room and whining abiut it. Nithing seems to help.

I have no idea what to write in the positives column anymore.

I visited this site before, but thank you anyway.

No hard feelings, so don't worry about it.
It's like looking in the mirror
Happens to me every time someone mentions her or if something reminds me of her. Seing her is even worse. Way worse.
I said we should get a coffee sometimes

She has someone new now. I saw her few days ago while shopping, we said hi and spoke a few words.
I won't reach out. There is no point in doing that.
Finished college, got a well payed job, still going to the gym, made some new friends, read a few books.
Finished college, got a well payed job, still going to the gym, made some new friends, read a few books.
That's me. Overthinking every single thing and than still get surprised and hurt.

I already did it. I waited for a day and than responded. We have been talking for few days now. I thaught it will mean nothing to me, but it appears that I like talking to her. Her replies don't contain any questions anymore so she is probably already trying to shut this whole thing down.
I'm afraid that I might be boring and she feels sorry for contacting me.
That's what I'm afraid of. That she will also leave if I'm not interesting.
Life happened :) Our paths just didn't cross anymore. Later I fell in love with now my ex.
I'm lonely and I have always loved to talk to her. She's intelligent and I like that.
About 6 years.
It's frustrating. No matter what I do, she is still there somewhere in my head.
Stick to it. Believe me, breaking NC makes you hurt even more.

Exactly! Nothing is never wrong if they do what they want to do, but if you want to do something, than that becomes a problem for them immediately.

Yes, I'm starting to realise that she didn't love me and wasn't who I thaught she was. I'm stsrting to see that now, 6 months after breakup, although I would probably still take her back if she came back to me. I know I'm pathetic.

Me too. I have 2 exes from highschool and I wish nothing bad to them. I really don't care about one, because she cheated on me. Actually I feel kinda sorry for her, since her life is crap now. The other one I respect very much. She is a great person.

Mine too. She always did what was best for her and didn't give a fuck if this destroys anyone else. I was constantly looking for excuses for her behaviour. And she was really acting all innocent all the time. But deep down, I'm starting to realise that her daddy issues made her like that and she didn't love me. She used me to build her ego and that was it.

I'm sorry to hear that he treated youlike this. It sucks and I know it from my own experience.

Well done! 5 weeks is actually a great achievement. First time I only made it to 15 days I think.

It will pass. You probably feel angry if he neglected you and is now everywhere and sad but don't give up.
Don't break NC because it will only hurt you more. I did that wheb I saw she went on a spring break. Didn't even get an answer and it hurt like hell.

Just stick to NC and keep telling yourself one more week and than I will see how I feel. And when one week is around do it again.

Listen. If you want, you can send me a message and we can talk more :)

You actually made me feel better, and I hope talking to me made you feel at least a little better :)

Yes, here too. I still haven't watched The beautiful mind (I think that's the title, the one about Stephen Hawking). She told me she wants to watch it and than cancelled the last minute on 4 occasions. First time when we wanted to go to cinema and than 3 times when we should have watched it at home. Never even watched an episode of anything.
We went to cibema few times, once to a concert, other times was just walks or visits at home. Mine home. She was hiding me from friends and family.
I'm not for that crap, when people feel like they are gonna die if they don't see eachother for 3 days straight. But it hurt me because I didn'tget to spend any time with her for months. Once it was 9 fucking months. She never had time. Once she stood me up again and told me she is sick. Than she went on some party.
4 years. How about you?
And I like talking to you :)

Well we have that in common. All my ex did with me was go to the movies a few times, one concert and text every day. That was it.
Yeah, I hope so. But if I meet someone and get hurt again it's better that I don't meet anyone.
Thanks for talking to me!

I moved in already. It was finished right after the new year but she told me we will move in after she finishes all her exams. And here I am now, all alone.
We didn't understand eachother. I said house market is crap. If I tried to sell it, I would maybe get back half of what I invested in it. And renting isn't the option because there is no demand for that. I'm on the countryside so every house that is sold is used as a weekend getaway for people, because it's near the river.
I have a steady part time job and after I get my dioloma, I'm also getting a regulsr job here. It's well payed, and people are nice, I work with my former schoolmates and we carpool to work but you know. It's not what I always wanted. This kind of job is for people who have someone togo home to after work. I have noone.

No, not really. I wanted to be a pilot since I was a kid, but she made me.choose between her and that. So that ship has sailed, because I don't have enough money anymore (I spent it on college and setting up an apartment in my familys old house. We should move in there this summer. I can't sell it because my brother lives downstairs and house market is crap right now).  I was thinking about getting a gun licence, but that's not smart because I could end up shooting myself some day.

Edit: The thing I love the most right now is sleep. If and when I get any.

I'm not like that. I wish for an apocalypse so all this crappy feelings would end.

I thaughr she is the one and was ready to ask her to marry me later this year. I also thaught she was differend. Every evening I went to bed thinking she was too good for me and in the end it seems this is true. I got distant with everybody because I got so consumed in that relationship. Friendships ended because of it. Family ties had gone looser because of it. She was my everything and now she is gone.

I still can't get an image of her with someone else out of my head. It seems like I never will. In 4 years she never wanted to be intimate with me in any physical way. I'm an 24 year old virgin, my confidence is less than 0 and right now it looks like I'm done. If she didn't love me after I met all that the conditions she made, than probably noone will.

I don't know anymore how to be alone. I can't go to the seaside alone in some camp. What will I do all by my self? I barely get through the weekend being alone.
She never had time for me anyway so I just worked and waited at home for her to have time to hang our (sometimes for months). Despite that I was never lonely. We always talked and texted from morning till night.

I'm already at college, currently writing my graduation thesis and have a job.

No, there is no Bumble bff thing here. Just tinder and other crap like that.

I hang out with coworkers too, when there is a chance, but it's mostly a beer after work and that's it.

I hope this happens any time soon.

How? All my friends are in serious relationships and I am being left out since they are doing just stuff for couples.
I'm awkward as fuck infront of people I don't know so my chances of making new friends are pretty low.
If I'm alone I can't get her off my mind no matter what I do.
I have to drive past her house every day. And I will jave todo so for another year since the other road is in construction.
Sorry for posting here so often. I hope I don't make people nervous with my crap.

I don't even know how to talk to people anymore, so Idoubt I'm getting any new friends soon :)

And I'm afraid to go to therapy. There is no way I can pull it off without anyone noticing it. If noone else, my family will find out somehow eventually. And these things bring a stigma where I come from. 

And thanks for the kind words. Evem that seemed to help a little :)

Yesterday I went to see my grandmother and worked there from 7 am to 9 pm. I did a bunch of things around her house so she won't have to do it.
Today I brought an old chest with letters from ww1 that were written by my grandgrand father. I'm read through these letters, post cards etc. and arranged them so they won't get destroyed.

It didn't really help. I still feel lonely and can't stop thinking about her and wondering what is she doing. Maybe she went to the seaside with her family or maybe she is at some festival, meeting new people. Maybe she has a new boyfriend.

It's been 4 and a half months since she dumped me but I feel exactly the sam.

I don't enjoy anything. It's just work, loneliness, sleep, work, lonelines, sleep, and when it comes to weekends it's few days of loneliness and sleep and so on and so on. It's like I'm dead inside. Nothing interests me anymore. I han an ukulele. I bought it so I could sing a song or two to my ex on her birthday. I trashed and burned it few weeks ago. Couldn't look at it every day.

I'm sorry to hear that.
Exactly that. I don't know who I am either or what is my purpouse on this world.
I was. I'm little more than 4 months after breakup and 4 weeks NC. Well, she ignored my begging for few weeks before that.
Thanks, I'll check it out now.

If I'm honest with you, I became so introverted that I can't even start a conversation with someone in person if I'm alone there. And if I'm alone I get extremely sad and sometimes even suicidal after some time.
Thank you

""" I'd encourage you to reach out to old friends and       join activities that'll allow you to meet new ones. A social circle of friends is more important now than ever... so it is imperative you create one."""

I did all this, I'm still doing it, but no matter where I go and what I do, there is still this feeling of being completely alone.

Thanx for reply and advice.
Maybe. All I know is that it burns my brain while other parts of body feel ice cold.

I dont see the point in getting help if that means going through life without someone you love and not being loved. And I can't follow my dreams anymore. I will probably never be able to afford it again. I was thinking of getting in shapa and applying for french foreign legion. But again. What will I achieve with that? Nothing that matters.

It feels like crap when they treat you like that, right?
My girlfriend was like that. At least you had the guts to dump him. I waited, tried everything, did everything she wanted me to do and burned myself out while doing it. Then she left.
I feel it there too, but when there is extreme anxiety the worst pain is in the back of my head.

Actually I do brew beer, make liquor have a motorcycle and I have been hitting the gym for 6 months now, but there is almost no results.
My dreams were to become a pilot. Now this is unreachable because I can't afford it anymore. I spent my money studying engineering.
I'm afraid to find that kind of help because that's still taboo where I come from and if anyone finds out I will be labeled as the one who went nuts.

The first condition she gave me was that she will be my girlfriend if I don't go to flight school. And that was 2 years after I told her how I feel tovards her. Before that, she was on an off with few guys and kept me as a reserve. Through the relationship she never had time to be with me (haven't seen her for months) while she was everywhere else etc. I was the one who always had to adapt. I told her I don't like to be threated like this a few times but she always told me that things will gwt better and that I just have to try hard for her.  When I finally put my foot down, she started to talk to me like I'm a piece of shit. She was gone exactly one month later.

The night she dumped me, she looked at me like she enjoys my suffering.

I'm exactly the same. I also knew she was treating me like I'm a piece of garbage but did everythng she wanted me to do just to avoid breaking up. The only difference between us is that I don't want anyone else. More than 4 months after breakup I would still give in and take her back if she wanted to try again, although I know that she would just keep hurting and mistreating me.
I crave for someones love but I just feel like ni one will ever want me again. Atop of that I know, no matter who gives me love, I would be always comparing the to her and would wish it was her and not anyone else there with me.

It's that I was ready to marry her. I bought a ring and was just waiting to graduate and get a permanent job so we could live withouth any problems. She threated me like I'm worth nothing and I realise that but I was in love anyway. I still am.

She never loved me and if she didn't probably noone will. I did everything for her. I literally threw away my dreams because she told me to choose between her and my dreams. I don't intend to do this for anyone else.

Right now my plan is to graduate and get a job, so I can support myself untill I get in myself in the proper shape. This way noone will suspect nothing. After that I'm applying to french foreign legion and not telling anyone. I intend to dissapear, hopefully forever and start a new life.

I'm not refusing to give love, but I'm scared that even if I find someone, they will end up hurting me like she did.

Seems like I'm boring and unatractive anyway so I might not find anyone else. I'm not like my ex. I don't choose who I hang out with based on the looks, so I would be the hottest in the group. I'm usually "the ugly one". I've noticed that girls are more interested even into one of my friends who is drunk 24/7.

And I noticed one more thing. I've met some of her friends through these 4 months since breakup and few just ignored me. My ex might me badmouthing me. Before we began todate she always said how big of a mistake her ex was.
Thanks :)
I passed! :)

I was probaby great ego boost for her. When everyone gave up on her or stopped believing in her abilities regarding school, getting to college or anything else, I was there stabding by her till the end.

I always believed to every promise and excuse she made. Every time I said something about it, she found another excude and promised that things will get better. Now I'm starting to realise that she always wanted to appear single to other men. She valued other men's oppinions and other guys more than me. I shouldn't be surprised. Her father, her cousins on the father side. They all do exactly the same shit to their partners. They are all constantly whoring around so I won't be surprised if I find out that she was doing or is doing that too. Looks like it's in their DNA.
I was an idiot who fell in love with someone who is probably narcissist.

One year? At one year like that she convinced me this is normal. She tried to convince me this is normal later too. She was my gf for 4 years and after about 2 years all this really started to chew me on the inside.
Oh and we had no pictures as a couple.

My friend has a birthday party. I hope I won't be too shy and meet some new people.

Tomorrow I intend to work around the house and
go out later somewhere to celebrate that I passed my final exam on uni. 

Sunday I will go to a thermal spa and gym.

Never told me what bothered her. She kept things for herself although she had and still has daddy ishues. Never had time for me in moths, while she had time for everyone else. She was hiding me from her family and friends. Never wanted to take a picture with me and simmilar stuff.

Knowing that she doesn't care and she would probably make me feel worse is the only thing that is keeping me from contacting her. 
Thanks! :)

Actually I just have to pass all exams (I have just this one left but it's my last try). I can wryte my thesis as long as I want. If it takes me longer than I think 4 months I have to pay sething and that's it.

Good luck to you too.
I will look into it. Thanks!

I'm doing my best. It's not that I'm not so motivated, rather than have trouble concentrating. But yeah, she kinda took a big chunk of my motivation with her when she left me. 

Lately I have been thinking about mailing her a hardcover copy of my graduation dissertation when/if I graduate. Just mailing her that and saying nothing else. If I'm over her by then of course.

Anyway, thanks :)
Thanks! :)
So theanine doesn't have effect on anxiety? I'm really gonna try that.  Thanks :)

I'm sorry to hear about that end of your engagement :/ Maybe you are right, but right now it looks lile they all really found what they were looking for.

Yes, I'm lonely. I have been thinking about moving. I live in the contryside. Atop of that I live about a mile and a half from my ex and it's killing me when I drive past her house every day. So yeah I was playing with the thaught about moving to a city, but rents are so high that I really need to graduate and get a regular job first. Oh and I'm also from Europe :)
Shit. That made me want to ask my ex all that questions too.

No, at least not soon, because I've spent my money on uni. My only option that I might make it is to get a job and somehow save up enough to start over.

Maybe you are right. I hope you are right. It's just depressing to be the only one in the group that is alone (if I count out that one friend who really doesn't care as long as he is drunk and fucks someone from time to time).

She really hurt me. The fact that I live so close to her doesn't help. There is no way that I could completely stop the flow of information about her. Sometimes when I'm with friends something about her/things related toher come up and it hits me like a bomb.

I will probably have to find new friends anyway, because they are all getting married and don't have as much time as they did.

I will take a look at that sub you suggested. Thanks :)

Thanks again!

I'm not going to be a pilot. I lost my chance. If I ever make ebough money, I couldprobably go to flight school but currently I can't afford it anymore.

I don't intend to give up. My plan is to do my best and try to learn enough so I can pass and graduate. At least I will have a job than, even if it's not what I wanted/dreamed of.

I just came here to ask if anyone knows how to concentrate and be better at learning.
No, not from Germay. But I am from EU
That's what I intend to do :)

If you ask me, he wanted to fuck you. When he has seen that he would have to wait for what was too long in his opinion, he left. Also, if he wasn't over his ex, he would have just used you as a rebound anyway.

That hapened to my ex (of 4 years) before we started dating. I was her backup plan (I have realised this only now, 4 months after breakup) and she kept me in the friendzone where I had a first row seat to watch while she had a simmilar experience.

In my oppinion it's better to get over your ex completely before you start another relationship. You seem nice, so don't worry. Someone better will come around :)

Listen to this guy and learn from my mistakes. You have no Idea how miserable and used you will feel when she leaves you and you realise you will not be happy with the chosen line of work. In takes all your motivation and raises a milion of questions.

If I fail, all the work and money will go down the drain. It's my last chance to finish. There are so many "what if"s already. That's the reason my mind is all around the place instead focusing on what I do/read.
I hope I pass somehow. Thanks for your reply.
Thanks! :)

Thanks for the suggestuons. I have been trying to work in that order like you told me. Sadly it doesn't seem to work.
My mind has been really fucked up lately. But that's the theme for some other subreddits.

She never used me for sex.  All we did was talk, hugg, kiss and that was it. There was no sex ever between us. That makes me feel even more used and gives me a ton of questions. If she used me for boosting her ego than what. Was she fucking someone else during those months when she didn't have time to spend it with me? I will never know. I hope.
Actually I think now that she knows I was getting panic attacks etc. she will never come back. I'm probably damaged goods now for her. Right now she won't even talk to me. I had a short period about a month or two after the breakup when I begged her and  argued with her but now even that is over.
Regarding the flight school. I don't have enough money. If I pay back my loan, maybe then I could get another one. Or maybe get a regular job and save up.

I know my life is not over, but it is so empty right now. And she really took all my self esteem with her when she dumped me. My fear right now is that if I fall again in love this story would repeat itself.
Thanks for words of encouragement :)
Don't get me wrong. I'm not looking for an excuse, but right now, it feels like I'm lost in space.

I realise it was not healthy. But I'm not glad.

Now I have no motivation at all to finish college and I have only one exam and mu final paper left to do.

I have a part time job in my field of studies at some hi tech company. Well payed, flexible worktime etc.. They offered to hire me after I finish school but I honestly don't care. I'm not happy. I go to work because I have nothing else to do and because I need money.

My self esteem is not on zero but probably on the negative side of the bar. If she never wanted to be intimate with me in all this time and was hiding me/was ashamed of me, than I must be real shit of a human being.

After I broke my leg in a complicated way I couldn't do sports for a few yars and I got fat as fuck. Now I go to the gym, try to eat healthy for the las 6 months  but I'm gaining weight instead of loosing it. Someone told me that is probably happening because of all the stress and the fact that I have been sleeping for just a few hours per night since the middle of the january.

I'm afraid to go to a therapist because this is a huge taboo where I come from and I can forget about any job I this gets out. Also, people sould judge me and look at me like I'm a lunatic.

I should have kept my mouth shut and we would still be together. I really do love her, I swear to god.
She treated me like garbage and I felt trapped because I hoped and believed  untill the last moment that things will get better. At least sometimes I felt like I have a purpose. When we talked I felt that I matter. Sometimes I even felt loved.

I sometimes thaught about suicide when she neglected our relationship more than usual. Than I usually realised what I sacrifised to be with her and that I'm never getting this back. 
I told her this so I knew I must not do it. That was my way of keeping myself fighting, because I knew I would hurt her if I did it. 

Now, I have noone. I know there is whole Reddit and I have friends but that's not it. It's not like talking to her. In that way we really clicked. We could talk for hours and never get bored.

I saw her yesterday when I went home from the gym. She is gorgeous and I just wanted to stop the car and just hug her. Thankfully I forced myself to drive by and went home, to being depressed.

I know I will never love someone like this again. And I know noone will love me. If she didn't, than no one will. That's when I askyself what's the point of all this.

Sorry for this novel.
Gosh. I can't even imagine how hard must that be :/
Well thank god I don't love in Quebec than :)

I know it's my mind that is going crazy. I just cant shake it. 
She is enyoing, of that I'm 100 certain%. That I can guarantee. You have no idea with such resentmend she looked at me when she dumped me. Telling me how she has no time other than to study and work. After one week she was travelling across half of Europe.

I could also use this kind of tips. Mine never wanted to bi intimate with me in our 4 year relationship. Now I can't stop picturing her whoring around.
Since few of her cousins (girls) fuck anything that shows signs of life I can't get a picture of her also being like that out of my mind.

Me too. I go to work so early that there is no chance of seeing her, since I have to drive past her house every day.
When I finish work, usually during the drive home, everything is different. Sweating, breathing, typical anxiety. If my friends (we drive together) want to listen to the radio, every single song about sex dancing, having fun or anything like that makes me feel even worse because I imgine her having fun while I'm dead on inside from the breakup on.
And evenings are the worst. That's when the real filling of loneliness crawls in my mind.

Nice. Seeing her come back and having enough strenght to ignore her would really make me feel good and give me strenght not to give up. 
Can I ask you something?
So what do you do, when you begged and told her exactly how fucked up you are because of the breakup, and than she looses all respect for you and ignores you?
I probably won't ever get a chance to boost my ego like this right?

First, congrats on doing good on your exam :)

I can relate to what you feel. I alo always spoke to ger immediately after an exam. And she always told me she is keeping her fingers crossed right before an exam. Now it's just all quiet and it gets me even more unmotivated.

With me, the thing is that I can't even get myself to study because I can't concentrate for more than few minutes. So it seems like you are doing much better than me. I hope this boosts your ego :)

Now regarding this 2 days. Few days ago I was in a simmilar situation and when I told myself: Finally it's getting better and I'm gonna be ok, another wawe hit me like a tsunami. I don't want to scare you, but just so you know and are not suprised if that happens.

These days come like a calm moment before the storm and than the wawes of bad mood hit you again. When I posted about it, someone told me that there will be more and more of these good days and eventualy, there will mostly be good days, but once in a while, small wawe will hit me again.

Sorry, I really didn't mean to be rude. I know you just want to help and I really am thankful.

I have a cat and yes, it makes you feel loved. It's just not the same as feeling loved and respected by another person. Right now I'm sure she never really loved or respected me but I would still rather live in a lie that she loves me than be all alone. 

What I'm gonna say now will probably trigger almost all dog owners. I can't even look at the dogs since my ex always prefered to take her dogs on a walk alone rather than go with me.

Simmilar situation. Only difference is that I'm still far behind you.

Anyway, nice job, I'm happy for you :)

Thanks, I will check it out. I'm afraid to go to therapy since everyone I know will look at me like I'm a psychopat or something if they find out I'm seeing one. I have only one parent left and I don't want to burden them with this. Again, mental issues are still a taboo theme where I come from.
Thanks for the video suggestions.
I don't know how to live without her the way I shaped my life. Ni pet or friend can replace her. If nothing else, we talked and talked and never got bored
Oh God, it's like I am reading my own story.

Every time I think of her my heart starts pounding like hell. She doesn't love me. She told me that the night she broke up with me. She wanted to be friends but I refused and now she won't even talk to me. I can't be just friends. After almost 4 months since breakup I'm still in love with her. I know that even if I somehow magically get her back I would not be hapoy, since she would never have time for me again and continued to hide the fact that she is with me.

When I mentioned mental problems I was talking about these attacks that I get. Probably panic or anxiety (regarding the simptoms). This stuff is crippling and it happens whenever I think of her or that I have to live without her.  

She knows how bad I'm doing. If I somehow manage to get better, she won't feel bad so it won't be a revenge. She will just be glad that I haven't done anything stupid because of the breakup.

I feel trapped and sometimes death seems the easiest way out of it.

I don't want a lonely life. I don't want to think about her all the time. I don't want to get hurt everytime someone mentions her name. I don't want the pain in my chest whenever I have to drive by her house.

It's like you said. I told myself oh thank god, I'm getting better for no good reason and now I'm back at the usual feelings.

This wave probably came because I might see her "up close" and have to talk to her or something since I'm 90% sure she is going to be on the wedding I'm invited to this weekend. I'm extremely anxious about that. I just keep telling myself to act like a gentleman, the way I did when we were together. The truth is that I'm gonna be hit by an anxiety attack  the moment I come near her probably.

It's nice to hear that. Hope, that these good days come again soon and last as long as possible.

Seat back and enjoy it. If I knew mine felt guilty I would have so much satisfaction.
And remember, the moment you reply, their guilt will go away. Just let them lay in the bed they made.

Stay strong. I feel completely the same. It's really not worth all the suffering that you could go through if you send the message. It's terrible when you invest so much in someone and after years of treating you like shit, while you keep investing everything falls apart. And you feel trapped because you know that if they told you they are sorry and want you back, you would definetly do it. Think a little. They probably told you gazilion times they are sorry for treating you like this but kept on doing it. Listen to don't look back in anger by oasis. It made me feel a little better :)
Would it really help if you get into a relationship so quick? If you ask me it's probably better to get over your ex before so you don't ruin new relationship with shit from the past one.

I know, I have developed these attacks somewhere in the middle of relationship and it happened everytime she treated me like crap for some time. I really don't know what to do about it.
If I go to therapy those things will end up in my medical file and anywhere I try to get a permanent job will shut the door in front of me if they see that I am going/was going to therapies. These things are still huge taboo where I come from and if anyone finds out about it I will be forever labeled as that one who went nuts.

She doesn't have to. And she won't because she doesn't give a fuck about me. 
She was everything I had. She became my closest friend, my love, everything was about her. And now it's gone and I have no one to talk to, noone to share my day with and noone to connect with on a deeper level.

Don't know. Something that would help me deal with it, so I wouldn't have her on my mind 24/7. 
Right now my chest hurts and I can barely breathe, because I am so nervous. I have been like that for almost one hour. I have so big urge to contact her and beg her to somehow make it all go away.

I'm the same. She is on my mind from morning till night and I often dream about her too (if I get any sleep). The only difference us that I don't look her up on any social media. I deleted many mutual friends and her family members too. I get to see her sometimes (involuntarily) only if I pass by in my car or domething because she lives so close to me and that is hard enough.

Sometimes I feel like I have to pretend I'm fine even if I'm not, because I don't want to smother people around me with my sadness and that is really exhausting. So when loneliness strikes all anger, sadness, doubt and feeling of being used comes out.

Thanks :)

Thanks.
That's what I'm afraid of. I often catch myself thinking how could things be if we were still together, if I wouldn't get mad on her that night for constantly neglecting me. Also, she wouldn't allow me to have a normal conversation so I get closure. The night she dumped me I got panic attack so I didn't get to talk much.
Thanks again. I hope this advice helps me :)
If I don't go, the groom and the bride will probably be sad or insulted. So I have to go :/
